title: Continuity of the coarea Jacobian on M and relative closedness of critical fibers
statement: Let N, m ∈ ℕ, M, U ⊆ ℝᴺ with U open and M ⊆ U, and f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵐ of class C¹ on U, and assume x ↦ tangentProjection M x (the orthogonal projection P_x onto T_xM) is continuous on M. Then x ↦ coareaJacobian M f x is continuous on M, and for every y ∈ ℝᵐ there is a closed set F ⊆ ℝᴺ with M ∩ f⁻¹{y} ∩ {x : coareaJacobian M f x = 0} = M ∩ F.
lean_statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (M U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U → ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M → ContinuousOn (coareaJacobian M f) M ∧ ∀ y : Rn m, ∃ F : Set (Rn N), IsClosed F ∧ M ∩ f ⁻¹' {y} ∩ {x | coareaJacobian M f x = 0} = M ∩ F
